display.purpose: The 'Moneyclip' masthead only — Archivo bold, widest stretch (wdth 112).

headline.purpose: Hero money figures (report/trip totals, detail price) — Archivo bold, tabular, wdth 110.

title.purpose: Sticky page headers (20px semibold, wdth 110) and record titles (24px bold).

body.purpose: All running copy and item titles — system CJK stack, never Archivo.

secondary.purpose: Merchant/date lines, captions, helper text — Faded/Night Soft Ink.

label.purpose: Section-card titles and metric labels — 11px semibold uppercase, +0.08em.

shadows.name: glass-edge
shadows.purpose: Specular inset stack carried by every glass surface (light values; dark swaps to white 12/7% + black 24%).

shadows.name: glass-float
shadows.purpose: Hovering chrome — headers and the bottom-nav capsule; card hover upgrade.

shadows.name: glass-deep
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and toasts on the deepest glass grade.

shadows.name: hairline-b
shadows.purpose: Divider under sticky headers — hairlines are shadows, not borders.

shadows.name: btn-cobalt
shadows.purpose: Primary action plate: specular lip + pressed-glass cobalt glow.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.value: 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; from opacity 0, translateY(14px) scale(0.98), blur(6px)
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance: surfaces settle into place with a breath of blur (nav, insights, report cards).

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: The toast pops once — quick and done.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Touch feedback by element size: pucks 0.90, buttons 0.97, chips 0.95, cards 0.99.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All authored motion is removable without loss of function.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid cobalt plate with a specular lip and pressed-glass glow — the only filled action style.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Translucent paper fill with a hairline inset ring for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 40%); color: var(--color-ink, #0f1d3d); border: none; border-radius: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 14px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'PingFang TC', sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hairline, rgb(15 29 61 / 9%)); transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 70%); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cobalt, #2148b8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter — glass at rest, solid cobalt plate when pressed; always text, aria-pressed.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip" aria-pressed="false">咖啡</button> <button class="ds-chip" aria-pressed="true">全部</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 14px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'PingFang TC', sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #0f1d3d); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 55%); backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.35); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 70%), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 26%), inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(15 29 61 / 4%), 0 1px 2px rgb(15 29 61 / 4%), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(15 29 61 / 18%); transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { filter: brightness(1.03); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-cobalt, #2148b8); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 28%), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 10%), 0 1px 2px rgb(23 51 126 / 30%), 0 10px 24px -10px rgb(33 72 184 / 55%); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cobalt, #2148b8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Hairline well, not a second glass layer — translucent fill + 1px inset ring, cobalt focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 45%); color: var(--color-ink, #0f1d3d); font: 400 16px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'PingFang TC', sans-serif; caret-color: var(--color-cobalt, #2148b8); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hairline, rgb(15 29 61 / 9%)); transition: box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-soft, #4a5a80); } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--color-cobalt, #2148b8), 0 1px 6px rgb(33 72 184 / 18%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cobalt, #2148b8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Record Card

narrative.overview: Moneyclip is a personal print journal of kept purchases, seen through liquid glass. One cobalt ink carries every surface: the app reads as a printed sheet — cobalt ink-washes at both horizons and a halftone dot field that fades out below the masthead — with iOS-26-style liquid-glass chrome floating over it. Density, weight, and tint steps of the same hue carry hierarchy; extra hues never do. The category-default dashboard-of-cards is refused: content is editorial, chrome is optical. The system is built for one canvas — iPhone 16 Pro Max class (440×956 CSS px), used on the sofa, on the commute, and in shops right after a purchase — so it is an Operate surface whose expression lives entirely in precise details: the specular lip on a button, the blur of a toast, the tabular numerals of a price. Glass here is a specific effect, not decoration: every translucent surface refracts the printed sheet behind it (fixed-attachment background), and inputs deliberately sit on glass as hairline wells rather than stacking a second blur layer. Dark mode is a first-class second substrate ("cobalt night"), not an afterthought: a .dark class on <html>, driven by a user setting (system / light / dark), swaps every token pair.
keyCharacteristics: Mono-color editorial ink: Cobalt #2148B8 dominant plate; hierarchy via density, never hue count.
Signal Red #C83232 is a control plate — expiry and destructive only.
Liquid glass in four grades (soft 12px blur → deep 40px blur), always over the real printed background.
Archivo Variable (self-hosted, wdth axis) is the display voice for mastheads and money; system CJK stack carries all body copy.
Fixed mobile canvas (max-w 440px), 8px spacing rhythm, 44px touch floor.
Two complete token substrates (paper light / dusk dark) kept in lockstep.

rules.name: The One-Ink Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only structural ink. Hierarchy is carried by density, weight, and tint steps of the same hue — never by introducing hues. If a screen needs a new color, it needs a different tint step instead.

rules.name: The Signal-Plate Rule
rules.body: Signal Red is a control plate, not a color. It appears exclusively on expiry state and destructive flow (warn → confirm → execute). Any other use of red is a defect.

rules.name: The Two-Substrate Rule
rules.body: Every color ships as a light/dark pair (paper↔dusk, ink↔dusk-ink, line↔dusk-line, cobalt↔cobalt-lift). Nothing ships light-only; the night substrate is re-derived per token, not dimmed with an overlay.

rules.name: The Display Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo Variable speaks only for the app's voice — mastheads and money. Body copy, labels, and chrome stay in the system CJK stack; Archivo is never set as body text.

rules.name: The Numbers-First Rule
rules.body: Every money figure is bold, tabular-nums, and honest: converted values carry ≈, unconverted ones are marked 未換算. Charts mirror every number as text; the SVG is decoration, the data survives without it.

rules.name: The Real Refraction Rule
rules.body: Glass always blurs something real: the fixed-attachment printed sheet (cobalt ink-washes + 1px/16px halftone field, masked out below 46% of the viewport). Chrome is never glass-over-nothing — if the background is missing, the glass is wrong.

rules.name: The No Nested Glass Rule
rules.body: Inputs sit on glass as hairline wells — translucent solid fill plus a 1px inset ring — never as a second blur layer. Glass on glass reads as mud.

dos: Do use the four glass grades for their jobs: glass-soft (cards, chips, rows), glass (generic surfaces), glass-strong (chrome: header, nav), glass-deep (dialogs, toast).
Do pair every color with its dark token and check both appearances; the night substrate is a re-derived palette, not a dimmer.
Do theme the browser surfaces: selection cobalt 22%, cobalt caret, thin scrollbars in the hairline color, 2px cobalt :focus-visible outline at 2px offset, patched autofill.
Do keep every interactive target ≥44px and give press feedback (active:scale-0.90–0.99 by element size).
Do convey status with a text label next to any dot or icon — color alone never carries status.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: both entrance animations off, all transitions clamped to 0.01ms.
Do feed the glass: any new full-screen surface keeps the fixed ink-wash + halftone background intact so chrome has something to refract.
donts: Don't introduce a second structural hue; reach for a cobalt tint step instead (One-Ink Rule).
Don't use Signal Red for emphasis, links, badges, or "hot" decoration — expiry and destructive only (Signal-Plate Rule).
Don't nest glass on glass; fields on glass plates are hairline wells (No Nested Glass Rule).
Don't put glass chrome over a flat or empty background — without the printed sheet the refraction dies (Real Refraction Rule).
Don't set money without tabular-nums, or let an unconverted figure pose as converted (≈ or 未換算, always).
Don't stretch Archivo into body copy or set the masthead in the system face; the display voice is reserved for mastheads and money.
